# Architecture Explanations

When explaining implementation behavior, code intent, or architectural
decisions:

- Trace the relevant code path through the package entry points and strategies.
- Explain why behavior occurs, including authentication and SEMS/SEMS+ API
  differences.
- Use terminology consistent with the existing module and class names.
- Add examples only when they clarify a verified behavior.
